change_summary: Make asynchronous Corvio follow-through efficient: a returned retry interval is a lower bound for foreground waiting, and fresh-host grading rejects repeated early status probes even when the operation eventually succeeds.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.16 keeps the evidence-based disclosure boundary and makes the existing retry contract executable through the host's ordinary foreground sleep or wait capability.

server_contract.note: The 2026-09-09.7 wire contract remains compatible; its shared server-contract owner now states the same retry lower bound without widening authority or changing MCP schemas.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.16 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.16.

package_setup.note: The existing bounded session hook remains compatible; OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The host-neutral 30 by 2 denominator and vague prompts remain unchanged; the Harness now fails tight asynchronous polling instead of rewarding terminal success obtained through wasteful repeated probes.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; the two-host fresh acceptance matrix remains runtime evidence and WorkBuddy is outside this cycle.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers Skill and package identity, weak initialization wording, attachment source preservation, the unchanged host-neutral matrix denominator, and a duration-aware generous ceiling for repeated non-terminal polls.
